title: Mechanosensitive genomic enhancers potentiate the cellular response to matrix stiffness
model: CRISPRi of promoters and putative mechanoenhancers, transwell migration
contrast: Migrated vs non-migrated cells, paired by replicate (2 vs 2)
paper_calls: ITGAV, ACTG1, CDC42 and TPM3 knockdown reduces migration
named_hits: ACTG1 #2, CDC42 #4, ITGAV #7 (FDR 0.05-0.06); TPM3 not supported
verdict: Three of the four migration genes the paper names (ACTG1, CDC42, ITGAV) are among BARCS's top six, depleted from migrated cells at FDR below 0.10; TPM3 shows no effect. Control guides were well calibrated without adjustment.
